subject: Co-sell & marketplace listing readiness for BlueHorizon Analytics
messages:
From: Sara Lin <sara.lin@bluehorizon.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@bluehorizon.ai
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Co-sell + marketplace listing for BlueHorizon

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week — the team at BlueHorizon is excited about listing our integration on the major clouds and enabling a co-sell path with Redwood. We’d like to understand the path forward and what you need from us to get both AWS and Azure listings live within Q4.

High-level asks from our side:
- A checklist of technical and commercial evidence for marketplace certification (metering, SKU mapping, security evidence).
- Typical timelines for catalog approval and co-sell enablement on each cloud.
- Any commercial commitments (minimums, pricing model) required to enable co-sell tags.

I’ve attached a brief RFI that summarizes our current infra and go-to-market commitments. Can we do a short call next week to align on a mutual action plan?

Thanks,
Sara Lin
Head of Partnerships
BlueHorizon Analytics
Attachments: BlueHorizon_RFI.pdf
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lin <sara.lin@bluehorizon.ai>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-sell + marketplace listing for BlueHorizon

Sara — great to hear, and congrats on the product momentum.

Quick notes and what we need to move forward (starter checklist attached):
1) Marketplace evidence:
   - Security: SOC2 Type II report (or in-progress with expected completion date), network topology diagram, and KMS/HSM details.
   - Technical: a packaged AMI/container image or marketplace-friendly deployment manifest, usage metering hooks (API or billing events), and sample billing SKU mapping.
   - Integration: demo account + short runbook we can use for validation.
2) Commercial/comms:
   - Baseline pricing model (list & committed discounts), and whether you’ll allow trial SKUs or metered trials.
   - Lead routing: preferred routing and contact for co-sell opportunities.
3) Timeline: generally AWS/ Azure listing + certification is ~4–8 weeks after we have all artifacts; co-sell enablement (partner badge + lead routing) can be parallel but may add 1–2 weeks of approvals.

I’ve attached our Redwood Marketplace Evidence Checklist to make it actionable. Can you populate the checklist and return it? If you want, Ben can host a technical intake to validate the metering hooks and packaging.

Proposed next step: 30-min sync Monday 10am PT — confirm if that works.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Alliances & GTM
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_marketplace_evidence_checklist.pdf
From: Sara Lin <sara.lin@bluehorizon.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@bluehorizon.ai
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-sell + marketplace listing for BlueHorizon

Vivek — thanks for the checklist and the clear timeline. 10am PT on Monday works for our team.

We’ve started filling the checklist — attaching a draft MAP and a few answers to the security questions. A few quick notes:
- SOC2: our Type II report is in progress; we expect completion end of September. We can provide the Type I and our controls matrix now.
- Metering: we have a usage webhook that emits per-customer metering events; Ben, we can share a sandbox endpoint for validation.
- Commercials: we plan to publish list pricing and a pilot discount tier (15%) for early customers; we’re open to discussing a co-sell revshare model.

Attachments: MAP_BlueHorizon_v1.xlsx

Looking forward to Monday.

—Sara
Sara Lin
Head of Partnerships
BlueHorizon Analytics
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Co-sell + marketplace listing for BlueHorizon — internal next steps

Internal — forwarding BlueHorizon’s draft MAP and the partially completed checklist. Quick asks before the Monday sync: 
- Ben: can you validate the sandbox metering webhook and confirm whether our runtime can consume their format without additional adapters? If not, estimate effort (dev days).
- Olga: please review the revshare ask and map the required contracting clause (we’ll probably need a co-sell addendum + listing SOW). Also flag any redlines we should expect from procurement.
- I’ll own the cloud listing intake and initial submission for AWS/Azure; plan to bundle both clouds in the same intake to speed approvals.

Quote from Sara below for context:
> We’ve started filling the checklist — attaching a draft MAP and a few answers to the security questions.
> - SOC2: Type II expected end of Sep
> - Metering: usage webhook available; will share sandbox
> - Commercials: list price + 15% pilot discount; open to revshare

Attachments: MAP_BlueHorizon_v1.xlsx, redwood_marketplace_evidence_checklist.pdf

If you can reply here with your short notes by EOD, I’ll fold them into the Monday agenda and HubSpot deal record.

Thanks,
Vivek

Redwood Inference
